newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares nudge new record, Astra.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares nudge new record, Astra.

text.p: The Stockholm share market buoyed by overseas bourses set a new record.
The market's general index closed up 1.33 percent at 2.223.16 in lively turnover totalling 5.02 billion crowns.
Unexpected news from the Federal Reserve that the U.S. had suffered its first decline in industrial output in seven months, implying U.S. interest rates might stay low, cheered world markets.

"There is an unprecedented shortage of stock and demand is scandalously strong," said one broker. "It doesn't seem to matter what you buy - putting a blindfold on and sticking pins is just as effective. It feels a bit like the 1980s."
Astra was the star on Friday, rising 7.50 to 307. Ericsson was unable to sustain its surge begun Thursday and eased 0.50 to 205.50 on profit-taking.

"There were probably not so many who thought Astra would manage to rise over 300 since options expired today, but it may be that many who issued a call option wanted to keep the share and went on to buy," one broker said.
Nordbanken climbed 10.50 to 193.50. Some brokers said there was speculation about a possible restructuring this weekend.
